model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the percentage of spending over a reference value of 2021, broken down by country and spending type. The vertical axis displays country names, ordered alphabetically from "Spanien" to "Tschechien," while the horizontal axis represents the percentage above the reference value, labeled as "% über dem Referenzwert von 2021," with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 4, and tick labels at intervals of 1. Each country is represented by a stacked bar, with the lower portion representing "Anstieg zwischen 2021 und 2024" (increase between 2021 and 2024) in blue, and the upper portion representing "Ausgaben 2021" (spending in 2021) in green. For example, the bar representing "Spanien" has a blue portion with an approximate value of 0.2 and a green portion with an approximate value of 0.5, while the bar representing "Tschechien" has a blue portion with an approximate value of 1.8 and a green portion with an approximate value of 2.2. Error bars are present above each bar, extending vertically. The bars are sorted alphabetically by country name, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the color differentiation of the stacked components.
